text:
sam: Heads-up — saw a 504s spike when requests had both X-Workspace-ID and X-VPC-ID set. Gateway seems to prefer header -> workspace routing but in Private installs we want VPC -> pool precedence. Anyone know current precedence rules?

linh: We documented precedence as: 1) explicit pool header (X-Redwood-Pool) 2) VPC binding (X-VPC-ID) 3) workspace header (X-Workspace-ID) 4) default routing. But looks like gateway code uses header-first and treats X-VPC-ID as hint only.

sam: repro snippet: `curl -H 'X-Workspace-ID: w-123' -H 'X-VPC-ID: vpc-9' https://gateway.redwood.internal/v1/generate` got routed to shared-hosted pool which didn't allow that workspace -> causes auth/quotas mismatch.

maya: if it's routing to shared pool, quotas get double-counted. We need telemetry to tag which constraint matched. Right now metrics only show pool, not match reason.

andre: propose adding `routing.match_reason` tag enum: pool_header, vpc_binding, workspace_affinity, fallback. Also add console column 'Matched by' in deployments UI. Minimal impact.

devex-bot: deploy-checklist: update gateway tests, add tag to telemetry, update console API, add migration script for existing metrics -> OK.

linh: also consider editorial: if X-Redwood-Pool present, we should ALWAYS honor (customer explicit). For VPC vs workspace, I vote VPC precedence for Private installs and workspace precedence for Hosted.

sam: agree. Implementation idea: routing policy = per-tenant override: `{ scope: 'private'|'hosted', precedence: ['pool','vpc','workspace'] }` default to ['pool','workspace','vpc'] for hosted? Wait confusing. Maybe keep deterministic: pool > vpc > workspace for private, pool > workspace > vpc for hosted.

maya: need config surface in Console -> Routing policy per workspace and per VPC. UX: dropdown 'Routing precedence' with explainers + 'show matched reason' toggle for logs.

andre: rollout plan: feature flag 'routing-match-reason' -> gateway can emit tag, rollout to canary tenants, update billing pipeline to not reprocess. Estimated 2 sprints.

sam: assign Linh to PR for gateway behavior, Maya for console change, Andre for telemetry + billing. I'll file GH issues. @devex-bot add jira tickets.

devex-bot: created tickets: RD-3456 (gateway precedence change), RD-3457 (telemetry tag), RD-3458 (console UX), RD-3459 (tests + rollout).

maya: small UX note: show 'why this request was routed here' in traces, not only console. +1 on tag enum.

sam: thanks :thumbsup:
